observation: ZN-E016 (P0 linear-ramp fade): only healthy physics term so far — violation 0.150 -> 0.044, SATISFIED, cosine +0.28..+0.38, RMSE 418.6, >1000 bias -921 — but MAPE 0.3433 because the linear ramp shrinks early break-in cycles of <500 cells (<500 MAPE 0.200 -> 0.217). ZN-E017 (P4b) failed structurally (R 2.07, cos -0.85, UNHEALTHY). P2 is unsupported on ZN-coin (Spearman(Delta V, log EOL) = +0.016). Frozen ZN-E010 P0c violation 0.149.
primary_hypothesis: A late-knee what-if (capacity x (1 - alpha r_n^2)), whose quadratic ramp barely touches cycles 11-50 (r^2 = 0.028 at cycle 25 vs 0.167 linear), keeps P0's physics benefit (held-out P0c violation -50% vs ZN-E010's 0.149, healthy balance) without the short-life break-in distortion, so accuracy does not fall: KEEP under §7 vs ZN-E010.
question_inherited: Was P0's accuracy loss caused by perturbing early break-in cycles?
unresolved_from_reference: Whether a late-only fade rule gives physics consistency without hurting <500-cycle cells.
why_this_experiment: loss.md §4.6 order P0 -> P4(b) -> P0c -> P2; Gemini ZN-E017 analysis; P0c is the natural repair of P0's early-cycle side effect while staying a registered physics term (one change vs ZN-E016: ramp r_n -> r_n^2).
modification: Loss only: L = RelativeHuber_0.15 + lambda * mean ReLU(f(x~) - sg[f(x)]), x~_{n,Q,dis} = x_{n,Q,dis} (1 - alpha r_n^2) on observed cycles, alpha ~ U(0, 0.150); lambda = 0.5 x median gradient ratio (unsigned calibration). Model and training identical to ZN-E010.
changed_components: Objective: added P0c late-knee physics term (label-free).
held_constant_components: Frozen ZN-E010 architecture (98,113 params, GELU, anchored fade encoder), Relative Huber delta 0.15 main loss, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, checkpoint rule, data.
controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps; lambda2 never tuned on validation.
expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE vs ZN-E010 and ZN-E016; held-out P0c violation vs 0.149; <500 band vs ZN-E010 (0.200) and ZN-E016 (0.217); lambda, R, cosine, active fraction; EOL-band bias; gradient gate.
rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs frozen reference ZN-E010 MAPE 0.3325 / RMSE 425.0 / Acc@15 0.3665 / DB-MAPE 0.3325). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3245 AND RMSE <= 435.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 404.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3355] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.3865 AND MAPE <= 0.3355 AND RMSE <= 435.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3365 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3425 AND gradient gate PASS AND loss balance PASS or SATISFIED (loss.md §5.3; BALANCE_FAIL -> DISCARD) AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Physics claim only if the held-out violation rate falls vs ZN-E010 and accuracy does not get worse (loss.md §4.6). If DISCARD, what-if physics stops and the lead takes stock (Gemini ZN-E017 analysis).
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput. Loss balance: lambda2, R_j median, cosine, active fraction (loss.md §5.3).
